title: Replies
summary: Reply to a message: the composer shows the message being answered, the sent reply shows a quote of it, and a tap on the quote scrolls to the original.

preview.description: One line of its text, or the media kind.

state.description: From InReplyToDetails.event: unavailable when the original is deleted, not loaded or can't be read.

replyingTo.description: The quote above the composer while a reply is drafted.

startReply.effect: From message-actions or a swipe right on the message: sets replyingTo and focuses the composer.

send.effect: Timeline.sendReply with the composer content (messageEventContentFromMarkdown) and the event id, then clears replyingTo.

eventId.description: The quoted event of a reply in the timeline.

loadQuote.effect: Timeline.loadReplyDetails when the quote is not loaded.

jumpToOriginal.effect: Scrolls to the original and highlights it for a moment. Back-paginates if needed; does nothing when unavailable.

notes: bipe_app_reply_to takes the sender's name. A reply to the person's own message uses bipe_app_reply_to_self.
A swipe to reply has a haptic at the threshold (registries/haptics.json).
Replies in threads are out of scope: no threads in phase 1.
